flags.why: The sentence-final particle is nà, not na, as recorded in the [dictionary entry for nà](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-n%C3%A0).
flags.fix: Remove this sense from na; it belongs under nà.

flags.why: Liên đới remains formal when it means interconnected or interrelated, so the untagged sense misleadingly suggests ordinary casual usage.
